objective.summary: Add a versioned, source-bound GridPolygon selection contract with explicit ordered-vertex authoring and exact save/reopen/Runner parity for irregular-region teaching.
constraints: Use the existing Core/Data/Shell/Viewer MVVM ownership and explicit Apply/Cancel workflow.
Keep E-13 as the single supported selection kind/role declaration; use only one explicit grid-polygon-authoring pseudo-step for authoring.
Do not add polygon-to-mask arithmetic, a region artifact, or a downstream inspection consumer without a separate SDK-owned contract and approved package boundary.
Do not execute Preview, Publish, Run, replace the source, or change an unrelated selection while drafting or restoring polygon setup.
Preserve existing user changes, ignored data, issue drafts, and the Dev/original repository boundary.
Do not change product version, package, checksum, tag, release, publication, deployment, commit, or push state.

criteria.text: A versioned GridPolygon selection contract stores a stable identity, exact root source/frame binding, and an ordered finite in-grid vertex list with deterministic fail-closed validation for missing, malformed, duplicate, degenerate, self-intersecting, out-of-grid, mixed-payload, stale, incompatible, and undeclared routes.

The Viewer and Workbench provide explicit GridPolygon vertex authoring/editing with visible row/column coordinates and order, add/remove/edit/reorder affordances, Apply/Cancel, Enter/Escape recovery, and transient draft behavior that does not execute inspection or mutate unrelated recipe/source/selection state.
E-13 contains one explicit grid-polygon-authoring declaration and no inspection tool or adapter is presented as a GridPolygon or mask consumer.
GridPolygon geometry and route survive exact JSON save/reopen, Workbench restore, and the existing Runner document-loading/parity path without source replacement or implicit execution.

Focused Core/Data/Shell/Viewer verification, the proportional Release build, and git diff --check pass; current-build Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 runtime evidence covers relevant normal, selected, editing, invalid, long-list/count, Apply/Cancel, keyboard, popup/layout, save/reopen, and no-execution states on the dynamically selected monitor, with unrun DPI scales named explicitly.

The D-backed recipe inspection reports schema 1.7 storage with one step and one selection, executionValid=True with no errors or warnings, and rejects the intentionally reordered outline as self-intersecting or overlapping.

Final current-build Wide and Compact EXE smokes pass. Both reports exercise numeric edit, a fail-closed invalid reorder, reorder restore, add/remove, Cancel, restart, explicit Apply, the 256-vertex transient editor round trip, and no Preview/Run execution. Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 screenshots pass quality; external evidence records the window intersecting the dynamically selected smaller left monitor \.\DISPLAY2. The shared ToolRecipeWorkbenchView Enter/Escape binding contract is present for Apply/Cancel recovery.

The closure record documents the final Release solution build at zero warnings/errors, focused command paths, D-backed evidence, dynamic monitor rule, current 125% DPI, unrun 100/150/175/200% DPI scales, no package/release mutation, and git diff --check pass.
